reuse.why: Extracts the saved-template predicate into one constant, but setZero gets a hand-written copy of the hidden-category query instead of a shared month-wide category selection.

duplication.why: The hidden/group-hidden filter is now written in four SQL queries plus copyPreviousMonth's JS check, and the template predicate is spliced into five separate queries; setZero's new query duplicates the set*MonthAvg one.

placement.why: Logic stays in budget/actions.ts, but the template exclusion is pushed into the generic getBudgetData accessor while the hidden rule for the same action stays in JS, splitting one rule across layers.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions' category selection and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: The 'which categories a month-wide action may write' rule remains spread over five query sites, so the next rule change again needs edits in each.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared category-selection helper exists in the tree; the change adds a SQL fragment constant rather than going around one.

disguised_duplication.where: setZero's new SELECT is an open copy of the set3/6/12MonthAvg query in budget/actions.ts.

one_place.where: Only the template predicate is a shared constant (NO_SAVED_TEMPLATES); the hidden and group-hidden part of the rule is still decided separately in setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg SQL and copyPreviousMonth's JS check, and each query must splice the constant itself.
